cohort: Placental biopsies were collected from 18 pregnant women with preeclampsia and 18 normotensive pregnant women.
finding: Statistically significant increases in pSTAT3 staining were detected in endothelial cells of preeclamptic placentas versus normotensive controls, while no significant differences were found for VEGFR1, VEGFR2, or VEGFR3 expression.
